dslRule:
<!id: remove-unnecessary-font-close-tag>
<!description: Removes an unnecessary '</font>' close tag from HTML string literals appended to a StringBuffer.>
<!severity: HINT>

$buffer.append("</font></body></html>")
=> $buffer.append("</body></html>")
;;
summary: Removes a redundant `</font>` HTML tag from a specific string literal when appended to a `StringBuffer`, correcting malformed HTML output.
